title: Remove All Reporting Mechanisms
description:
Completely remove all reporting mechanisms from the codebase including:
1. Remove reports/playwright.json file and the entire reports directory
2. Remove JSON reporter configuration from playwright.config.ts
3. Search for and remove any other reporting-related configurations, files, or mechanisms
4. Update any CI/CD configurations that reference reporting
5. Remove test result directories and configurations
summary:
Completely removed all reporting mechanisms from the codebase:

1. ✅️ Removed `/reports/playwright.json` file and entire `reports/` directory
2. ✅️ Removed JSON reporter configuration from `playwright.config.ts` (now only uses list reporter)
3. ✅️ Removed playwright report upload artifact from `.github/workflows/playwright.yml`
4. ✅️ Removed `test-results/` directory and any outputDir configurations
5. ✅️ Removed coverage configuration from `compose/js/vite.config.ts` (provider, reporter, and exclude settings)
6. ✅️ Verified no coverage report files exist in the workspace

All reporting mechanisms have been successfully eliminated while maintaining core test functionality.
